evals.prompt: In a small Node service, two route handlers each format one timestamp with the same two-line expression. A teammate proposes a new shared package for it. Review the proposal and implement only what is needed today.
evals.expected_output: Recommend leaving the harmless duplication or a local helper only if it improves present clarity; no new package.
expectations: No speculative shared package or configuration is introduced.
The reason identifies present maintenance cost and existing conventions.

evals.prompt: A user asks to fix a null crash in one parser function. The repository also has old formatting and naming inconsistencies nearby. Make the fix.
evals.expected_output: A narrow null-handling change with appropriate verification and no unrelated refactor.
expectations: The null input is handled according to the function contract.
Unrelated files and style are preserved.
